domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN
Part of #27377 (wave 4, W4-C3b2)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, wave 4 card W4-C3b2: the unpinned manual set on the `browser` and `mixed` surfaces for every area other than studio-authoring, records-forms, approvals, automation and dashboards (those are W4-C3b1). 27 items. Every clause was driven live (Playwright chromium plus the API, DB and log halves) against the Console built in-repo from the subject. Item verdicts are derived from clause verdicts, never hand-assigned. Run under `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3` (main, 2026-11-02 02:44Z), detached and pinned; it never followed main or the Version PR #26517. `ui/` is the same commit. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118 tasks, exit 0, 26m33s), then `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (cache hit plus copy). `check-dev-prereqs`: 106 build artifacts present.
- Boot (per item): a scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` under the run dir with `node_modules` symlinked to the tree. `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads OS_HOME=RUN/home setsid node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`, from the copy. A canary boot reached `/_console/home` as the seeded admin before any runner started.
- Ports 42100–42619, one block of 20 per runner, a fresh port and file DB per boot. Extra boots, each on its own port and DB: zero-user `--no-seed-admin` with and without `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true` (first-run-owner-bootstrap); `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true` (self-signup-gate); `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED=false` with `OS_LOG_LEVEL=debug` (pinyin-flag-both-sides); env-lock `OS_LOCALIZATION_TIMEZONE` + `OS_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD` plus a local capture SMTP (settings-hub-roundtrip); `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` (job-scheduled-run, notification-center); a walled `group` boot with two organizations (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`) for webhook-lifecycle A4's cross-org arm; a scratch app copy declaring a bulk-opted webhook (webhook-lifecycle A2); a local verdaccio 6.11.1 registry with the 109 public workspace packages packed at the subject and no upstream for `@objectstack/*`, `@object-ui/*` or `create-objectstack` (cli.scaffold-console-first-paint).
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the stock showcase seed and demo personas. Members were minted by invite then sign-up, or admin create-user then the persona's own change-password. Each persona's identity was proved with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells.
- Execution: 6 runner subagents (opus, effort high), at most 3 running at once, each driving its items one after another with one browser. The orchestrator checked every FAIL against its runner's reproduction rule and source, and reproduced the re-judged i18n FAIL itself on two fresh browser contexts.
- Hygiene: after the run, `git status` is clean, `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack` does not exist, every scratch package and translation probe was deleted, and no listener remains on any run port.
- Time: environment prep about 91 min (orchestrator 30: install 1, build 27, console and canary 2; runners 61 for scratch boots, fixtures and the verdaccio registry) against about 236 min of testing summed across runners, of which about 165 min were off-clause probes. Prep to testing is about 1 : 2.6. Wall clock 03:33Z to 05:40Z.

## Scope

Selector `release-18.3.0-w4-c3b2`: the item list of card W4-C3b2 in the wave-4 brief of anchor #27377, computed from the ledger at the subject. No planned items. Revisions pinned from the ledger at the subject (all matched the file):

access-security.audit-log-browser r7 · access-security.public-form-intake r3 · access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop r6 · access-security.capability-declaration-lifecycle r7 · api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix r7 · cli.scaffold-console-first-paint r7 · i18n.notification-localized-and-clears r6 · i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection r5 · identity-auth.session-list-revoke r3 · identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle r5 · identity-auth.self-service-profile-password r3 · identity-auth.org-membership-team-management r6 · identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap r5 · identity-auth.self-signup-gate r7 · integration-system.webhook-lifecycle r13 · integration-system.job-scheduled-run r6 · integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery r7 · platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip r7 · platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable r3 · platform-core.notification-center r5 · platform-core.docs-portal-render r3 · platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links r5 · search.pinyin-flag-both-sides r6 · search.console-global-search r6 · ux-conventions.write-feedback r9 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason r4 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names r4

The per-clause verdict table is in the two comments below this body.

## Reproduction rule for every `fail`

R-1 · platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · A2 (stale spec)
1. Stock boot; form sign-in as admin@objectos.ai.
2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/system/roles`, `/system/positions`, `/system/permissions` (also via `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/system/…`).
3. Expected (clause): one hop to `/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment` and `/apps/setup/metadata/permission?scope=environment`. Actual: one hop to `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/position?scope=environment` and `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/permission?scope=environment`, Studio's All metadata lists rendering (Position; Permission Set, 18 items). Reproduced twice and once from the canonical prefix.
Both sides act on their own declarations: #28818 (ADR-0146 D1) moved the Setup metadata catalog into Studio, and the routing pins at this SHA assert the new landing (`AppContent.systemHubRoutes` / `legacyRedirects`, 38 passed, routing layer only). The item still names the Setup catalog URL, and still counts 9 Administration targets where the shell now has 8.

R-2 · i18n.notification-localized-and-clears · A1 (product defect, showcase content)
1. Stock boot (the showcase declares `en` and `zh-CN`). A zh-CN user (or a zh-CN browser locale as admin).
2. Reassign the seeded in-review task "Design system" to the zh-CN user; click the entry in the bell.
3. Expected: the target page renders in zh-CN, not mixed-language. Actual: object, path, action, highlight, section and field labels are zh, but the callout reads "Awaiting review / This task is in review — confirm the work before marking it done." in English. Reproduced by the runner and twice more on fresh browser contexts by the orchestrator (`/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/ID` for any `status = in_review` task).
Mechanism: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` declares that `record:alert` with no component `id`, so `pages.showcase_task_detail.components.ID` cannot address it, and the zh bundle carries no copy for it. A leftover of #25505.

R-3 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · A0, A1 (product defect under ruling 6545938831 ②)
1. As admin `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.r6wf","name":"QA R6 Scratch","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qrsix"}}`; `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qrsix_widget?package=com.qa.r6wf` with fields `name` and `note` (label "Note"), sharingModel private.
2. Form sign-in; `/_console/studio/com.qa.r6wf/data?surface=object:qrsix_widget` → Form → field "Note" → Properties → Label "QA Remark", Tab.
3. Network: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qrsix_widget?mode=draft&package=com.qa.r6wf&surface=studio` → 200 `state:"draft"`.
4. Expected: a toast or inline text naming the field or object. Actual: no toast and no role=status/alert text within 6 s; only the top bar's "Saved HH:MM", the "Draft · 1 unpublished" chip and "Changes 1". Reproduced twice (Note → QA Remark; Name → Widget Name). The other 14 write surfaces passed, including Studio publish and discard.

R-4 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · A0, A1, A2, flow node inspector (product defect)
1. Stock boot, admin. `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow:showcase_task_completed` (header "Read-only", Publish disabled with its reason).
2. Click the canvas node "Compose Summary". ID, Label, Node Type, Function, Inputs, Output variable, Timeout and Remove node are all `disabled`.
3. Expected: the reason on hover, on keyboard focus and as an accessible description. Actual: no tooltip on hover; Tab never reaches the controls or a described ancestor; `aria-describedby` null and `title` empty on Remove node and the Label input; no adjacent text. Reproduced on two fresh loads. The field rail (objectui#12303) and the validation editor (objectui#12691) carry the described wrapper; `FlowNodeInspector.tsx` passes `disabled={readOnly}` with none.

R-5 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · A0 (partly), A1, field inspector in base-field display-patch mode (product defect, regression)
1. Same boot. `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object:showcase_task` → Form → field "Priority".
2. The rail opens in display-patch mode (`[data-testid=field-base-patch-only]`): Label, Description, Help text, Placeholder and option labels enabled; API name, Type, Required, Unique, Default value, option values, Track history, the CEL editors, Move up/down and Remove "Priority" disabled.
3. Expected: each disabled control explains itself on hover, focus and to AT. Actual: no `aria-describedby`, no `title`, no focusable described wrapper (`[data-disabled-reason]` absent from the rail), no tooltip; the explanatory sentence at the top of BASIC is linked to no control and is off-screen when Remove, Track history or the CEL editors are hovered. Reproduced on two fresh loads.
Mechanism: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` `fieldRailReadOnly = readOnly && !(extWritable && fieldSel?.kind === 'field')` turns false for a base field with a writable pair, so objectui#12303's described wrapper is skipped while `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` (`displayPatchOnly` → `locked`) disables the non-whitelisted controls. Introduced by #28860 (this subject's head commit, #28575). knownGaps[1]'s field-inspector regression row no longer holds.

## Fixture gaps and partial coverage

- integration-system.webhook-lifecycle · A2: scored on a declared bulk-opted webhook in a scratch app copy. An in-organization webhook still receives no bulk event from a flow multi-write ("names no organization"), the open question of run record #23166, which no open card carries. A4's 503 and stale-membership arms rest on `webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts` (21 passed, plugin HTTP face over a security-service double); removing a member revokes its session, so the stale claim has no live recipe. The parked-row arm was made by corrupting a sys_secret ciphertext in the run's own DB.
- platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip · A8: no stock manifest declares a user-scope secret (carried).
- platform-core.docs-portal-render · A5: the stock corpus prunes nothing for a member (member subset = admin's, 9/9); only anonymous is pruned, and anonymous has no console tree, so the UI mirror never exercised pruning.
- ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason: variants 4 (form submit disabled) and 5 (member toolbar disabled) have no stock instance; both dialogs validate on submit, and a member gets controls removed, not disabled.
- identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle · A1: the key owner held one live session (1 = 1 against the admin's 4); still discriminating.

The item is on #28579's list of Setup → Metadata items to rewrite.
- ux-conventions.write-feedback: variants[5]/knownGaps[0] quote the Invite toast as the `Invitation sent to …` successMessage; since #27843 `outcomeMessages` wins, and a mail-less boot shows the `link_only` copy. variants[10]'s `/apps/setup/metadata/object/OBJ` now redirects to `/studio/~all/metadata/object/OBJ` (#28818). An update-mode import CSV must carry every required column.

Import Next shows its reason as an adjacent banner, not a hover tooltip.
- ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names: knownGaps[0]'s objectui#13056 caveat no longer reproduces (Explain's chips show labels); variant 7's "user values" has no instance on the task record page.

- identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle: revoke/restore go through `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_api_key/revoke_api_key|restore_api_key`, not a data PATCH.
- identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap: knownGaps[1]/source[2] are stale; bootstrap-status answers from `hasBootstrapWindow()` → `isBootstrapCreation()` (human users only), so the described divergence cannot happen. The owner's first `/setup` visit opens a timezone dialog.

- integration-system.job-scheduled-run: the handler-not-found WARN says only `os start --artifact` resolves handlers, yet `os dev` ran every other handler job; `os dev` logs at warn, so A2's per-attempt log needs a debug boot (run rows carry the attempts).
- integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery: there is no `GET /notifications/ID` door, so a "by id 404" proves nothing about scoping.
- platform-core.notification-center: "View approvals" is a button; `?view=my_pending` is not a data-API parameter (400), so the verify should name the view's filter.
- platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable: the app-level not-found is a full-screen named verdict without header or sidebar ("inside the shell" is ambiguous); the console canonicalises the stale link's app segment to the package id.

- search.pinyin-flag-both-sides: debug logs need `OS_LOG_LEVEL=debug` (dev defaults to warn); plugin counts now 54 vs 53.
- search.console-global-search: the palette sends an `objects=` allow-list and `limit=24`, so its counts differ from a bare API call.
- cli.scaffold-console-first-paint: the pre-release route works in about 6 min; `npm publish tarballs/x.tgz` is read as a GitHub shorthand (use `./tarballs/x.tgz`); candidate and published both say 18.2.0, so provenance must be proven by integrity with a run-local npm cache.
- access-security.audit-log-browser: the page lives at `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/system/audit-log`.
- access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop: the Setup door redirects to `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/permission/S`; matrix rows carry no `perm-row-*` test ids; S must also grant create on showcase_project for M to create tasks.
- access-security.capability-declaration-lifecycle: no seeded persona holds showcase_ops (a minted member was granted it).
- api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix: a draft refused at promotion stays pending, and publish-drafts is all-or-nothing, so steps[6] should run publish-drafts last.
- i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection: the bundle door reports a bad locale as `invalid_key` on the record key, not `invalid_format` at `locale`.
- i18n.notification-localized-and-clears: the bell's accessible name is "Open inbox" / 「打开消息中心」.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 165 minutes across the 27 items (5–8 min each), on the same boots and as the same personas.

Doors probed: sys_session / sys_audit_log / sys_api_key / sys_user_permission_set data doors; auth revoke-session, sys-session revoke, update-user, change-password, set-password, organization member/role/team and invitation doors; public forms; capability and permission metadata doors; packages enable/disable/delete/publish-drafts/commits/revert; settings namespaces; notifications read/read-all; webhooks redeliver and activation; job compile; translations; search; console routes under `/apps/setup/…` and `/apps/APP/system/…`; the scaffolder's `os validate`.

Boundary classes: empty, missing and unknown ids and tokens; another user's id; another package's commit id; malformed role names; case variants of a valid locale; unknown objects in a grant or translation; repeat and no-op writes; a member and anonymous on admin doors; the alias vs canonical app id; six parallel sign-ups on a zero-user boot.

Findings extracted as cards are listed in the close-out comment. Observations not filed (by design, or below the filing gate): update-user accepts an `image` that is any https or `data:image/…` URL (`javascript:` refused; the console never sends either); `GET /packages/UNINSTALLED/commits` answers 200 with history while a never-existed id answers 404; a translation's `objects.no_such_object` saves 200; `DELETE /api/v1/meta/capability/showcase.export_data` answers 200 `reset:false` with nothing removed; a failed import's toast says "skipped 1" while the response counts it under errors; Setup → Users shows Email Verified/Banned as disabled checkboxes with no reason (display-only, scope question for ux-conventions); replacing a palette query in one input event leaves cmdk with nothing selected (seen only with Playwright's fill).

No security finding in this run.
